about: CIRCA's creator library: every creator and every video in the demo. All media is stored inside the app (public/media/live), so it plays anywhere, including inside the claude.ai preview. Run `npm run content:demo` after editing.

howTo.addCreator: Copy a creator block, give it a new id, and list its content. Songs go to Music and the Radio, episodes to the Radio, innerCircle posts to Inner Circle.
howTo.playback: video: a file in public/media (src + poster). youtube: an official YouTube upload by videoId (plays only where YouTube's player is allowed; not in the claude.ai preview). instagram: an official Instagram embed by url.
howTo.innerCircle: Behind-the-scenes only: rehearsals, studio sessions, soundchecks, tour moments. Never a polished video or a full episode.
howTo.credits: Every item records where its footage and music come from and under what licence. The app lists them in Settings, Credits.

sources.artists: Demo identities (names, bios and captions are invented) on licensed stock footage of real performers from Mixkit, with licensed music from Mixkit's composers. The performers are not the people named.
sources.podcasts: Real NASA shows and episodes; long ones are excerpted. NASA media is public domain; NASA does not endorse CIRCA.

display.note: How videos sit in the vertical feeds. fill: cropped to fill the screen. fit: whole, with a soft glow in the creator's colours around it.

creators.name: Ellis Rae
creators.description: Writes in a brick-walled room in Bushwick with one good microphone and the lights low. Low Light is the first thing he's let leave the room.

content.title: Low Light
content.blurb: Unhurried alt-soul for the last hour before sleep.

content.caption: Rehearsal with Danny. He keeps changing the chords on me and he's right every time.
Take nine. Leaving the crack in the voice in.

creators.name: Marisol Vega
creators.description: Grew up on her grandmother's bolero records and plays them back through a soul band. Candela was recorded live in one afternoon.

content.title: Candela
content.blurb: Piano, double bass and a bolero heart, played slow.

content.caption: Warming up in the old ballroom before the first take.
This room has better acoustics than any studio I've paid for.

creators.name: Juniper & Lowe
creators.description: A guitar and a banjo that met busking outside the same coffee shop. They still play the street on Sundays.

content.title: Paper Lanterns
content.blurb: Front-porch folk with nowhere to be.

content.caption: Sunday busk. Someone's kid danced through the whole set.

creators.name: Kairo Banks
creators.description: Records at night after shifts at his uncle's shop. Night Shift is the sound of that commute.

content.title: Night Shift
content.blurb: Late-night bars over a slow, heavy beat.

content.caption: In the booth till 3. Verse two finally sounds like me.

music.title: Can't Get You Off My Mind
